title: Beef, sliced, with gravy, potatoes, vegetable, frozen meal

content.title: About
content.content: This is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal that contains thinly sliced beef in a savory gravy, boiled potatoes and a vegetable medley. The dish is designed for quick reheating in a microwave or on the stovetop and provides a balanced mix of protein, carbohydrates and vitamins.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The beef is pre‑seared before freezing, which helps retain juiciness after reheating.
The gravy is made from beef stock and a small amount of natural flavorings.
Potatoes are cut into large cubes to maintain texture during heating.
The vegetable mix typically includes carrots, peas and corn, adding extra vitamins and fiber.
Frozen ready meals are popular in fast‑paced societies and are often used as convenient office lunches.

items.title: High-quality protein
items.content: Beef provides a complete source of protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Iron and zinc
items.content: Red meat is rich in heme iron and zinc, which support immune function and energy metabolism.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The meal contains B12, B6 and niacin, which help maintain a healthy nervous system.

items.title: Fiber from vegetables and potatoes
items.content: The vegetable medley and potatoes add dietary fiber, aiding digestion and satiety.

items.title: Moderate fat content
items.content: The gravy includes a modest amount of plant‑based fats, making the dish more balanced than fried meat.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Prepared gravies often contain added salt; people monitoring sodium intake should account for this.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Food preservatives may be used to extend shelf life and can cause reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: A small number of people may be allergic to beef or to ingredients in the gravy.

items.title: Heating requirements
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave harmful bacteria; follow the recommended temperature and time guidelines.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Defrost the package in the microwave or on the stovetop, heat until the internal temperature reaches at least 75 °C, stir to coat the meat and vegetables evenly with gravy. Serve immediately, optionally garnish with fresh herbs or spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen meal at –18 °C or lower. Once opened, store in the refrigerator for no more than 2‑3 days and reheat thoroughly before consumption. Do not refreeze after thawing.
